# AJ Cleaning Home

> Recurring house cleaning in Miami and across Florida. Weekly, every 2 weeks or every 3 weeks, plus one-time deep, move-in/move-out, post-construction, Airbnb, office and listing cleaning, in-home laundry and add-ons. Small team, the same faces every visit. English and Spanish.

- Phone: (305) 680-4609 (calls and WhatsApp)
- Email: ajcleaninghome@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm (flexible)
- Payment: Zelle or bank transfer. A 25% deposit holds the booking.
- Prices are quoted per home after a free request (property type, size, bedrooms, bathrooms, frequency). Recurring plans cost less per visit; weekly is the lowest rate.
- Service area: Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Aventura, North Miami, Miami Beach, Brickell, Coconut Grove, Miami Lakes, Hialeah Gardens, Kendall, Homestead and the rest of Florida on request.
